up: Retrieve exact activity values and chemical structures for compounds tested in assay CHEMBL1613970. Return the compound ChEMBL ID, standard activity type, standard relation, standard value, standard units, and canonical SMILES. Filter for exact activity values only (standard_relation = '='). Do not apply any row limits.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
  md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id,
  a.standard_type,
  a.standard_relation,
  a.standard_value,
  a.standard_units,
  cs.canonical_smiles
FROM activities a
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE
  ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1613970'
  AND a.standard_relation = '='
